bifrost: none app-facing. Private chart drawing in springboard/src/shell/screentime/chart.rs and springboard/src/shell/battery.rs (Body::Graph in springboard/src/shell/list.rs)
summary: Swift Charts is a declarative SwiftUI API for marks, scales, axes and plots, with 2D, vectorized and 3D (macOS 26) charts. BifrOSt has no app-facing chart API in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src. Two shell-only drawers exist: the Screen Time bar chart and the battery 24-hour bar graph, both hard-wired to their own data. Nothing from the framework's mark, scale, plot, annotation or 3D surface model is available to apps.

gaps: No app-facing chart API: no Chart container, no marks, no scales, no axes, no plots in springboard/sdk or springboard/ui
The Screen Time bar chart and the battery graph are private shell drawers, not reusable by apps
No line, area, point, rectangle, rule or sector marks
No automatic scale domain, no axis grid lines or configurable ticks, no annotations
No chart proxy, so charts cannot respond to pointer position or selection
No 3D charts or surface plots (Chart3D is macOS 26.0 in Apple's docs)
No chart accessibility summaries or localized axis labels
docs/bifrost-ui.md has no dataviz or charts section, so the Apple parity record does not cover this framework
